bio: Hi! I am Jonathan Yang, a first-year student from Carmel, Indiana. I live in Stoughton Hall and have not decided on my major yet, but am considering Applied Math and Statistics. I also love sports, although I have been playing tennis for a majority of my life. I am a big football and basketball fan, with the Colts and Pacers being my favorite teams. I have recently been trying to learn a few instruments and learn more about music. I am super excited to be a part of Harvard’s First Year Social Committee and am excited to work with my peers!
